title: lotononis involucrata subsp. peduncularis
intro: Lotononis involucrata subsp. peduncularis, commonly known as Pockiroo, is a plant species native to Australia. It has been traditionally used in Indigenous Australian medicine to treat various health conditions, including fever, colds, and respiratory issues. The health benefits of Pockiroo plant include its antimicrobial, antiviral, and anti-inflammatory properties, which may help alleviate symptoms associated with these conditions. The therapeutic actions of Pockiroo are attributed to its bioactive constituents, which include alkaloids, glycosides, and flavonoids that may exhibit antioxidant, immunomodulatory, and antiparasitic activities.
